validation.method: Born-digital PDF with a real text layer: every table parsed with pdftotext -layout (indentation read from the description column position), pages 2, 7, 11, 17, 21, 23, 35 and 39 checked by eye against the page render, and the part-number column of every table page OCR'd from a 200-dpi render and matched to the parsed rows in order (683 of 685 exact; the other 2 are C45900 with the "O" of "O RING" run into it). Copies compared: the attached file is the newer of the two archive copies ("8-3340  IEC Front Cut.pdf", modified 2002-11-16) and is byte-identical to it; the older "(rev 2002-10-27)" copy differs only on the paint and oil page (PDF p5), and "Front Cut Tractor Models, 5720V,5818V,5820V,5822K.pdf" (2018 save) renders identically on all 45 pages. The draft claude/LOOKUP_8-3340_parsed.json was used only for comparison. User decisions of 2026-11-23 applied (old paint/oil parts added, 5818V engine C44853 inferred, cross-shaft key C37752, tail weight kind, tail wheel component variants, TractorData set on all four models, electric deck lift optional).
validation.refContinuity: Ref gaps (kept as printed): engine_vanguard 9 and 13; base_assembly 29; body_assembly_5720v 23 and 38; body_assembly_5818v_5820v_5822k 23 and 29; seat_lid_steering 13 and 14; single_tail_wheel 5; drive_assembly_rh 7-9; drive_assembly_lh 7-9 and 26; electrical_system_vanguard 19. All other sections continuous. Repeated refs are L.H./R.H., per-model or alternative rows (e.g. decals 1, 3, 11, 13-15; drive pulley 12, 16, 28). 83 unnumbered rows (22 on the paint and oil page, incl. the 2 added from the older copy; the rest are indented sub-parts, wheel parts, mounting hardware and kits), each flagged.
validation.quantities: All table rows have a quantity except seat lid ref 23 (NSS arm rest kit, none printed); 13 rows are UAR; decals ref 15 C46953 prints "I" (stored 1). The newer paint and oil page prints no quantities (20 rows, qty empty); the 2 rows added from the older copy carry its printed qty 1. No REQ'D column out of register (text layer).
validation.numericalIndex: The book has no numerical index (only the alphabetical index of sections, PDF p4): cross-check not applicable. All 25 alphabetical index entries map to sections (the electric deck lift entry covers both deck lift tables).
validation.partNoForms: Case letter prefixes and hardware codes stored closed up; six printed with stray spaces (C41 015, C31 947, C 14304, 131 -911, 131 -71, 131 -356), printed form kept in partNoAsPrinted and flagged. One Briggs number (BR93805, booster fan ref 2) stored bare as 93805. 26 NSS rows (source null). Cross-shaft ref 2 stored as C37752 (printed C37725, user decision). Paint code 10-5688 (M & W Plum) kept as printed. Sources: case 450, case-hardware 231, briggs 1.
